newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA- REPO AUCTIONS MAY START AT END OF APRIL.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA- REPO AUCTIONS MAY START AT END OF APRIL.

text.p: Lithuania's central bank said on Monday that it might begin repo auctions at the end of April.
"The repo auctions might commence at the end of this month, but this will depend on the situation in the market," Jonas Niaura, the deputy govenor of the Bank of Lithuania, told Reuters.
Niaura said that the immediate situation in the market did not warrent repo auctions as banks did not face liquidity problems.
He also said that a number of administrative and technical procedures had to be dealt with before the auctions could be launched.

"The legislative basis for repo auctions is in place...now we are in the process of signing agreements with the central depository, commercial banks and the central bank's settlement department," Niaura said.
"We are also training employees at the commercial banks on the technical aspects of repo auctions," he added.
Repo auctions are the first stage in the central bank's two to three year plan to gradually scrap the currency board system.

Under the system, which deprives the central bank of most monetary policy tools, the bank guarantees that it will have one dollar in reserve for every four litas in circulation, freezing the exchange rate at that level.
